content_sections.heading: A&N DHS ANM & Laboratory Assistant Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 65 vacancies have been announced across the two posts.

content_sections.heading: A&N DHS ANM & Laboratory Assistant Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying. ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery): Passed Senior Secondary Examination (XIIth Std.) from a recognized Board/Institution Must have passed the ANM Certificate Course with a valid ANM training certificate from a recognized Institute Laboratory Assistant: Passed Senior Secondary Examination (XIIth Std.) from a recognized Board/Institution/University with Science Subjects Diploma in MLT (Medical Laboratory Technology), 2-year course, from a recognized institution Candidates should note that these are the essential qualifications listed in the official notice, and no relaxation or equivalent-qualification clause has been mentioned.

rows.age_limit: 18 - 33 years for male candidates; 18 - 38 years for female candidates

content_sections.heading: A&N DHS ANM & Laboratory Assistant Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for both the ANM and Laboratory Assistant posts will receive a fixed remuneration of Rs. 18,434/- per month, as per the official notice. No separate allowances or TA/DA are mentioned; in fact, the notice explicitly states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview or for joining the contract appointment.

content_sections.heading: A&N DHS ANM & Laboratory Assistant Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection for both posts will be made through a Walk-in Interview . Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria and whose names appear in the list of eligible candidates published on the DHS website will need to appear for the interview at the Conference Hall of the Directorate of Health Services, A&N Administration, Sri Vijaya Puram, on the tentative dates of 05.10.2026 to 07.10.2026. No other selection stage, such as a written examination or skill test, has been mentioned in the notice. Candidates must report to the Directorate at least 01 hour prior to their scheduled interview date and time, and must carry their original certificates and documents relating to proof of age, educational qualification, and other relevant details.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for A&N DHS ANM & Laboratory Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The application process for this recruitment is offline only; there is no online application (apply online) facility mentioned in the notice. Download the prescribed Application Format from the vacancy link on the official website ( andamannicobar.gov.in or dhs.andamannicobar.gov.in ). Fill in the application form with accurate personal, educational, and contact details, and affix a recent passport-size photograph. Attach self-attested copies of proof of age, educational qualification, and experience/employment (if any), as applicable. Submit the completed application, along with the required documents, at the Directorate of Health Services, A&N Administration, Sri Vijaya Puram, on or before 21.09.2026, 4:00 PM. Check the DHS website on 28.09.2026 for the list of eligible candidates. Eligible candidates should appear for the Walk-in Interview on the tentative dates of 05.10.2026 to 07.10.2026, carrying original documents. Original and self-attested copies of proof of age (e.g., birth certificate/Class X certificate) Original and self-attested copies of educational qualification certificates Proof of experience/employment, if applicable Aadhaar Card and PAN Card Recent passport-size photograph Any other document mentioned in the application format

content_sections.heading: A&N DHS ANM & Laboratory Assistant Terms and Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely on a contract basis for 06 (six) months, or till the posts are filled on a regular basis, whichever is earlier, and can be terminated at any time without assigning any reason. This engagement does not confer any right or privilege to claim regular appointment in the Health Department. Selected candidates should be prepared to serve at any Health Institution under the Directorate of Health Services, as required by the Department. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the walk-in interview or for joining the contract appointment. Furnishing false information or suppressing material facts can lead to removal from contract service and further action.

faq.question: Q1. What is A&N DHS ANM & Laboratory Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview notice released by the Directorate of Health Services, Andaman and Nicobar Administration, for engaging 65 candidates as ANM and Laboratory Assistant on a 6-month contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are 65 total vacancies – 51 for ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery) and 14 for Laboratory Assistant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for offline receipt of application is 21.09.2026, till 4:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: ANM candidates need XIIth Std. pass plus a valid ANM Certificate Course. Laboratory Assistant candidates need XIIth Std. pass with Science subjects plus a 2-year Diploma in MLT.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: For ANM, the age limit is 18–38 years for female candidates. For Laboratory Assistant, it is 18–33 years for male candidates and 18–38 years for female candidates.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an online application (apply online) option?
faq.answer: No. The application must be submitted offline, in the prescribed format, at the Directorate of Health Services, Sri Vijaya Puram, on or before the last date.
